answer: Past the lantern, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Decay keeps the economy honest: an identity that stops contributing loses its privileges, so bought or farmed reputation has a shelf life. The saffron turns sybils into a treadmill — the farm must keep all its clones working forever, and the moment it stops, they are worth nothing. That is the point of the ocean: cloning stops paying the moment each copy costs as much as the original.
